about_the_game:
🔥 Ecchi Overflow – Hentai DLC

Turn up the heat with 140+ brand-new puzzle levels paired with steamy hentai-style artwork that’s designed to thrill.

Ecchi Overflow is a bold, fan-service-heavy expansion filled with provocative poses, revealing outfits, and flirty anime characters across a wide range of seductive scenarios.

🌟 What’s Inside:

  • 140+ new puzzles with unlockable explicit hentai-style images

  • Nude and semi-nude characters in suggestive, erotic poses

  • Outfits include latex, swimsuits, fishnets, school uniforms, nurse outfits, and more

  • Themes cover wild girls, sci-fi heroines, post-apocalyptic vixens, princesses, and classic anime-style homages

  • Rich in fan-service with teasing expressions, sultry eyes, and provocative setups

Whether you're playing through puzzles in a rainy sauna, jungle temple, or cyberpunk city, every image rewards you with bold and spicy visual content.
